item.text: {"claim_scores":[{"claim_id":"c1","score":"1","rationale":"Uses one `dspy.Predict` plus `dspy.JSONAdapter` flow across three LM variants and inspects all three outcomes: schema class, `{\"type\": \"json_object\"}`, and no `response_format`."},{"claim_id":"c2","score":"1","rationale":"Shows `supported_params` gating by omitting `response_format` when the LM does not advertise it and asserting that absence on the plain LM call."},{"claim_id":"c3","score":"1","rationale":"Includes an LM with `supported_params={'response_format'}` but `supports_response_schema=False` and asserts DSPy sends `{\"type\": \"json_object\"}`."},{"claim_id":"c4","score":"1","rationale":"Includes an LM with both capabilities enabled and asserts `response_format` is a generated `pydantic.BaseModel` subclass."},{"claim_id":"c5","score":"1","rationale":"Uses a simple `answer: str` output signature, avoiding open-ended mappings and `ToolCalls`, so the comparison isolates LM capability flags."}],"question_score":100,"needs_regrade":false}
